contract: Every file must produce a typed diagnostic. No crash, no out-of-bounds read, no unbounded allocation.

truncate_half.dxf.reason: Truncated at 50% of the byte length.

truncate_mid_entity.dxf.reason: Truncated inside the first wall LWPOLYLINE's vertex list, in the ENTITIES section.

no_eof.dxf.reason: Valid content with the EOF marker removed.

not_dxf.dxf.reason: Plain text with no DXF structure.

nan_coordinate.dxf.reason: Vertex 0 X of the first wall LWPOLYLINE is nan.

infinite_coordinate.dxf.reason: Vertex 0 Y of the first wall LWPOLYLINE overflows to infinity.

absurd_coordinate.dxf.reason: Vertex 0 X of the first wall LWPOLYLINE is 1e30, beyond any sane extent.

nan_coordinate_second_vertex.dxf.reason: Vertex 2 Y of the first wall LWPOLYLINE is nan, mid-loop rather than at the head.

huge_vertex_count.dxf.reason: First wall LWPOLYLINE declares INT32_MAX vertices and supplies 4.

negative_vertex_count.dxf.reason: First wall LWPOLYLINE declares -1 vertices and supplies 4.

understated_vertex_count.dxf.reason: First wall LWPOLYLINE declares 2 vertices and supplies 4.

non_numeric_group_code.dxf.reason: The group code preceding a wall vertex X is not an integer.

enormous_string_value.dxf.reason: The first wall LWPOLYLINE's layer name is two million characters.

mutual_block_cycle.dxf.reason: CYCLE_A inserts CYCLE_B which inserts CYCLE_A.

dangling_block_reference.dxf.reason: INSERT names a block with no definition.

binary_truncated.dxf.reason: Binary DXF truncated to one third of its length.
